purpose: Small primary-source reading receipts; no full text committed.

inspections.short_excerpt: The output is computed as a weighted sum of the values, where the weight assigned to each value is computed by a compatibility function of the query with the corresponding key.
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀§3.2的query/key/value向量、§3.2.1的dot product→softmax→weighted sum，及§3.4 learned embeddings與decoder output到next-token probabilities。支持操作關係，不賦予「查筆記」人類認知含義，也不把小算例當訓練效果。

inspections.locator: §3.1 opening paragraphs and validation/test leakage explanation
inspections.short_excerpt: Learning the parameters of a prediction function and testing it on the same data is a methodological mistake ... to hold out part of the available data as a test set.
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀§3.1開頭及hyperparameter/test leakage段；留出題不參與參數學習，若反覆用最後考卷選設定仍可能洩漏。本節只說留出題檢查能力，沒有承諾單次小例可證明泛化。

inspections.version: PyTorch Tutorials 2.14.0+cu130 documentation; page Last Verified 2024-11-05; fetched 2026-10-16
inspections.short_excerpt: parameters (model weights) are adjusted according to the gradient of the loss function with respect to the given parameter.
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀模型weights定義、autograd角色與Computing Gradients的loss.backward()/w.grad；只支持參數、梯度與更新的基本關係，不拿tutorial的GPU版本字樣證明本機GPU行為。

inspections.version: Official documentation HTML retrieved 2026-10-16, hash-pinned original
inspections.short_excerpt: Jev evaluates typed questions against a state and returns structured results directly. ... You get typed values and probability distributions
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀Introduction與primitives表：state加typed questions，Choice/Score有probabilities，Noul回0–1。支持R.4的Jev式判斷介面角色；不支持未公開商業架構，也沒有證明本課C已訓練完成。

inspections.short_excerpt: DPO optimizes for human preferences while avoiding reinforcement learning.
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀§1的兩種偏好訓練流程、§3的SFT/reward model/RL optimization及§4直接policy preference objective；支持DPO與PPO-based RLHF是可選不同安排，不是必須依次全套用。不採用論文效果數字為本課結果。

inspections.locator: §2, MoE routing Eq.(2) and Switch Routing
inspections.short_excerpt: the output computation of the layer is the linearly weighted combination of each expert’s computation on the token by the gate value
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀§2的FFN replacement、top-k MoE合併與Switch top-1設計；支持MoE屬架構/路由的選擇，並非偏好對齊或壓縮必做階段。本課使用top-2由s4/s6核對，不誤稱Switch原論文設定。

inspections.version: arXiv:2404.19737v1, 2024-04-30; downloaded unversioned endpoint resolved to v1 PDF header
inspections.short_excerpt: at each position of the training corpus, the model is instructed to predict n future tokens at once
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀§2的next-token loss到multi-token loss、shared trunk/heads與inference可僅用next-token head；支持MTP是訓練目標及可能的推論安排，非所有助理必須使用。不引用本論文的加速/品質數字支持本課。

inspections.short_excerpt: The second category quantizes the weights and / or activations of a CNN from 32 bit floating point into lower bit-depth representations.
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀§1把quantization放在模型尺寸/推論部署成本問題下、§2整數算術概覽；只支持它與對齊/路由不同角色，不把CNN實測外推為本課LLM收益。

inspections.short_excerpt: use a different kind of training, which we call “distillation” to transfer the knowledge from the cumbersome model to a small model that is more suitable for deployment
inspections.inspection_note: 實讀Introduction的training/deployment區分與小模型轉移，以及後續soft targets/temperature段；支持蒸餾是教師到學生的另一種學習/交付安排，沒有聲稱每份助理都需要教師。
